tracks.title: Content platform
tracks.subtitle: Auth, safe uploads and search that stays fast as content grows.
tracks.goal: Ship a small content platform where people sign in, upload a file, browse their own content and search it.
milestones: A private document page returns 404 for another user.
An avatar upload rejects a non-image and a file over 2 MB.
Search and category filters combine and pagination stays stable.
The list page runs a constant number of queries for 20 rows.
tracks.proof: A working content list with private ownership, validated uploads and a searchable paginated index.
tracks.explain: This track proves you can connect authentication, authorization, uploads and query design into one user-facing workflow.

tracks.title: Commerce
tracks.subtitle: Stock, transactions, caching and a safe operational command.
tracks.goal: Build the backend slice of a small shop that can sell the last item without overselling.
milestones: Two concurrent checkouts cannot both take the last item.
The dashboard aggregate is cached and invalidated after an order.
The cleanup command is dry-run by default.
Deleting data requires an explicit confirmation flag.
tracks.proof: A checkout flow with row locking, a cached aggregate, invalidation on write and an auditable command.
tracks.explain: This track proves you can reason about consistency, cache ownership and destructive operations — the parts that break in production.

tracks.title: API surface
tracks.subtitle: A small DRF API with ownership, pagination and predictable ordering.
tracks.goal: Expose a notes API that a mobile client can use without ever seeing another user's data.
milestones: Each user sees only their own notes.
Create assigns the owner on the server.
tracks.proof: A paginated, authenticated API with queryset-level authorization.
tracks.explain: This track proves you can design an API boundary, not just a serializer: permissions, ownership and stable collection output.

tracks.title: Product craft
tracks.subtitle: Forms, reusable UI and a cache-aware read path.
tracks.goal: Build a small product editor with a polished form, a reusable status component and a fast dashboard read.
milestones: The editor updates only title/body and never exposes owner.
The status badge works in two templates.
The dashboard cache is invalidated after a write.
tracks.proof: A small editor with clean form boundaries, reusable presentation and a deliberate cache.
tracks.explain: This track proves you can keep product code small: the form owns validation, the tag owns presentation and the write path owns cache invalidation.
